BiblicalUsage: This word means dark in the sense of obscure or low, and its one appearance sets the diligent man against mean men, the low and unnoticed. Diligence lifts a man to stand before kings, while obscurity is where the careless stay.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God sees the diligent even when men call them obscure, and He is the one who brings them before kings.
